premise.claim: Issue #534 Task 2: 'The readiness helper returns without applying the custom NotReady condition when the RoleInstance lacks the corresponding readiness gate. getInstanceReadyCondition() does not account for the lifecycle custom readiness gate when recomputing Ready. updatePodsLifeCycle() does not include this custom gate when deciding whether to mark component Pods NotReady. A RoleInstance can therefore remain blocked in PreparingDelete without reliably making its Pods NotReady.'
